_comment: What the question-card handling was verified against in the shipped app. DSH renders the composer's question card as a <section> whose question sits in the card's own <header> and whose pager sits in its <footer>, and each option is a flex <button> whose label and description are <span> cells. The layer needs both facts to be true — the frame's data-question-key is what tells it the landmarks are the card's own parts, and the flex row is what makes those cells blockified — and both fail silently if a build moves them: the card then reads exactly as it does without this plugin. scripts/check-card-pins.mjs reads them out of an installed app.asar and fails, naming the difference. Run it before a release (see docs/releasing.md) — it is not in CI, which has no DSH install.

frame.note: the frame around the card; index.js exempts the card's own landmarks through it

landmarks.note: the card draws its own parts with landmark tags, which is why the tag half of the chrome test yields inside it

cells.note: a flex row blockifies its inline children, so the label and description cells are text blocks of their own; optionCopy is a flex item too (flex:1)

plugin.note: index.js must still carry both halves: the card marker and the blockified-cell probe
